item.title: Major Releases in Spring AI 1.1
item.description: Spring AI offers a complete ecosystem: the Admin platform for visualized management and Dify integration; the Agent Framework for rapid development with built-in workflows; and the Graph runtime for flexible, stateful multi-agent orchestration. This full-stack solution streamlines building, managing, and running sophisticated AI agents.
